name: english-shelf
description: Manage English Shelf study content, curriculum, reviews, and meaningful learning records from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Study, review, and capture meaningful English progress.
interface.longDescription: Uses the same local SQLite database as the English Shelf Windows app to manage words, sentences, curriculum units, spaced reviews, and concise learning records at meaningful study milestones.
defaultPrompt: Show the English words due for review.
Save a new English word with its meaning and example.
Search my English sentences for a phrase.
Study the next curriculum unit and record the learning at a natural milestone.
